name: ai21
description: AI21 Labs is an AI research and product company with an office in Tel Aviv, Israel. Their mission is to build advanced language models and writing-tools that enable humans and machines to collaborate in thinking and creating.

sources.notes: AI21's official event page lists the AI21 Labs office at 14 Leonardo Da Vinci St., Tel Aviv.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified; the source supports an office in Tel Aviv, not an exclusive headquarters claim.
